title: GET /api/app-switches, and the answer to PUT /api/app-switches/<id>
description: Which apps are on (docs/apps.md). PUT adds changed and download.

pinned.description: Work mode: whether a pinned copy exists. Null outside work mode.

changed.description: PUT only: the app that was turned on or off.

download.description: PUT only: the command to run on this computer when an app turned on in work mode is not downloaded yet, else null.

canTurnOff.description: False for Home and Settings, which are always on.

separate.description: Always false: every app is part of Workshop (apps from their own repos ended in Nov 2026).

inWorkshop.description: Work mode: whether the pinned copy has it. Otherwise the same as on.

key.description: Separate apps: the repo name, used by workshop apps on <key>.

folder.description: Separate apps: the checkout in use, or where workshop apps on puts a new one.

ref.description: Separate apps: the release tag or branch of the checkout, or null.

command.description: Separate apps not downloaded yet: the command that downloads one. Otherwise null.

problem.description: Separate apps downloaded with an app.json that is not valid, so the pinned copy leaves them out: why, in plain words. Otherwise null.
